Subject: MAP playbook: Week 1 cadence & owners | Acme evaluation

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks for the time last week. As discussed, I wanted to kick off a short, structured MAP (mutual action plan) to keep our eval moving toward a July close. High-level proposal below; please confirm or suggest changes:

- Cadence: weekly 30-minute syncs for the next 4 weeks (proposal: Tuesdays 11:00 AM PT)
- Goal: complete model/eval gating and procurement checklist; go/no-go decision by week of 2026-07-13
- Success criteria (initial): functional integration with sample app; p95 latency <= 250ms on our test harness; 3 representative prompt sets validated for safety/accuracy
- Primary contacts / suggested owners:
  - Redwood: Marissa (customer success / demo & prompts), Karthik (solutions / eval tech), Rishi (commercial / pricing)
  - Acme: Jordan (procurement), Priya (security)

Attachments: MAP_Playbook_v1.xlsx (playbook & schedule), Acme_Eval_Criteria.md (proposed test cases). I also attached a short security screener we typically ask for.

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm Tuesday cadence (or pick alternate)
2) Marissa to send calendar invite for Kickoff (30m) and share short pre-reads
3) Karthik to prepare the initial eval harness and list of test prompts by 2026-06-21

If that all looks good I’ll send calendar invites and upload the MAP to a shared Drive.

Thanks —

Tessa Morgan
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0123
https://redwood.ai

[Attachment: MAP_Playbook_v1.xlsx] [Attachment: Acme_Eval_Criteria.md] [Attachment: security_screener.pdf]

Thanks for pulling this together. Tue 11:00 AM PT would work better for most of our team; can we lock that in instead of Mondays? Also two quick asks from Acme:
